motions.description: Motion to excuse Trustee Lollino from this evening's meeting.
Motion to approve all items on the consent agenda, including minutes, bills and vouchers, license applications, and various ordinances and resolutions.

Motion to grant permission to Shari Mallard, Girl Scouts of America, for Fall product sales September-October 2025 and Cookie sales December 2025 to January 15, 2026 at various locations throughout the Village.
Motion to approve a raffle application submitted by Kevin Kumar, Aging Care Connections, for their fundraiser September 19th at Elmcrest Banquets.
Motion to receive and file a recommendation to approve the facade improvement application submitted by Nikki Mahon for Turning Point Studio.
Motion to approve a Resolution Authorizing the Execution of a Facade Improvement Program Agreement between the Village of Elmwood Park and Nicole Wilk Mahon.
